name: UK Biobank Imaging Enhancement (Brain + Cardiac + Abdominal MRI)
size_human: ~6 PB (estimated; brain alone ~1+ PB; full imaging package across organs)
format_recommended_training: NIfTI per organ extracted via UK Biobank pipeline
agent_notes: 100,000 participants now scanned, ~20k re-imaging done by end-2025. Application 6-12mo, fee-based. Multi-organ MRI per visit; largest population MRI dataset on Earth.

name: OpenNeuro (BIDS aggregate, MRI subset)
size_human: ~1 PB aggregate (1000+ datasets, MRI is majority)
agent_notes: AWS Open Data s3://openneuro.org/ no-sign-request. 1000+ BIDS-validated datasets, mostly fMRI/dMRI/structural. ds000113 (Forrest), ds002785 (AOMIC), ds004215 (NIMH) are large. Use DataLad for selective fetch.

name: ABCD Study (Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development)
size_human: ~80 TB raw (T1/T2/dMRI/rs+task fMRI x 11,880 subj across baseline+follow-ups)
agent_notes: 11,880 youth across 21 sites, 10-year longitudinal follow-up. NDA application typical 2-6 weeks. Harmonized 3T protocol; structural+dMRI+rs/task fMRI.

name: HCP Young Adult 1200 (Human Connectome Project)
license: HCP Open Access Data Use Terms (registration)
agent_notes: 1206 healthy young adults (twins), gold-standard high-quality MRI. AWS Open Data via S3 bucket hcp-openaccess (requester-pays for 7T). 5400+ TB distributed cumulatively. Used for connectomics & dMRI.

name: ADNI 1/2/3/4 (Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative)
agent_notes: Application via IDA/LONI typical 1-3 wk. Rich multimodal: MRI+PET+CSF+genetics. ADNI4 phase active 2022-2027. Most cited AD imaging dataset.

name: HCP Lifespan (Aging + Development)
agent_notes: HCP-A: 1200+ adults 36-100+; HCP-D: 1300+ youth 5-21. Full multimodal MRI. Latest release 1390 ppl/2789 sessions/42 TB. Successor to HCP1200 with lifespan coverage.

name: BIOMEDICA (BMCA-CLIP archive)
license: Mixed PMC OA: CC0/CC-BY/CC-BY-SA commercial subset + CC-BY-NC non-commercial subset
agent_notes: Largest open biomedical image-caption corpus from PMC; ~24M pairs, 27 TB raw. Stream via BMCA-CLIP. Radiology subset only a fraction; metadata fields enable filtering by modality. Likely overlaps PMC-OA/MedICaT/ROCOv2.

name: CT-RATE: Chest CT volumes paired with radiology reports
agent_notes: VLM-PAIRED GOLD: 25,692 chest CT volumes with paired radiology reports. CT-CLIP/CT-CHAT/GenerateCT foundation models built on this. Largest open paired CT-text corpus. HF terms gate access.

name: CT-RATE
agent_notes: 25,692 chest CT vols / 50,188 reconstructions, 21,304 patients, paired free-text reports. CT-CLIP foundation model basis. Also indexed as ct/ct_rate; dedup target id: ct/ct_rate.

name: fastMRI (NYU): Knee + Brain + Prostate + Breast k-space
size_human: ~17 TB (knee 1.6 TB raw + brain ~9 TB + prostate ~2 TB + breast ~4 TB)
agent_notes: 1398 knee + 7002 brain + 312 prostate + ~300 breast cases. PRIMARY k-space dataset for accelerated MRI reconstruction. Fully sampled; supports unrolled net training. Each breast case ~4.5 GB; total ~17 TB.

name: NLST: National Lung Screening Trial
agent_notes: MASSIVE: 26k subjects, 21M+ CT slices, 11+ TB. TCIA imaging now open (CC BY 4.0). Full NLST clinical metadata still requires NCI/CDAS application. Best low-dose lung CT pretrain corpus.

name: OAI (Osteoarthritis Initiative) Knee MRI
size_human: ~8 TB (3T DESS + T2 mapping over 4 visits, 25,729 studies)
agent_notes: 4796 subjects ages 45-79 with annual MRI for 4 years. 26M+ images in archive. Sagittal 3D DESS-we is workhorse sequence. NDA registration ~1-2 wk. Best for knee OA progression.

name: MIMIC-CXR Database
agent_notes: VLM-paired (full radiology reports, gold standard). DICOM. CITI training + DUA required. Use mimic_cxr_jpg if you don't need DICOM.

name: MIMIC-CXR-JPG v2.1.0
agent_notes: Same 377K studies as MIMIC-CXR but JPEG (preprocessed) + CheXpert/NegBio labels. JPG is bigger than DICOM (uncompressed 8-bit decoded). Dedup target id: xr/mimic_cxr.

name: SKM-TEA Stanford Knee MRI
agent_notes: 155 qDESS knees ~25k slices. 1.6 TB raw k-space + DICOM + segmentations + pathology bboxes. Multi-task: reconstruction + segmentation + detection. AIMI registration.

name: MedTrinity-25M
format_recommended_training: HF parquet via MedTrinity preprocess pipeline
license: Mixed (per-source: CC-BY-4.0, CC0, OpenRAIL, MIT, PhysioNet credentialed, Stanford RUA, CC-BY-NC variants)
agent_notes: 25M images across 10 modalities with multigranular captions (disease/modality/region/relations + bbox/seg). 18M accessible. Aggregated from MIMIC-CXR/CheXpert/PadChest/CT-RATE/BRATS24/etc.; check sub-license per shard.

name: OASIS-3 (Longitudinal Aging/Alzheimer's)
agent_notes: 1378 ppl 42-95yo, 2842 sessions over 30 years. 6534 longitudinal clinical assessments. Free registration. Multimodal MR+PET. Bridge dataset between IXI (healthy) and ADNI (gated).

name: INSPECT (Stanford CT-PA + EHR)
license: Stanford AIMI Research Data Use Agreement (non-commercial)
agent_notes: 23,248 CTPA scans + paired report sections + longitudinal EHR (demographics, dx, procedures, vitals). NeurIPS 2023. Image-only Stanford Medicine cohort; CT-PA-specific. Possibly overlaps ct/inspect.

name: RadGenome-ChestCT
agent_notes: Extends CT-RATE with 665K grounded multi-granularity reports + 1.3M grounded VQA pairs + 197 organ seg masks. Region-anchored sentences. Overlaps ct/ct_rate (same volumes); dedup target id: ct/ct_rate.

name: AAPM Low-Dose CT and Projection Data
license: CC BY 4.0 (head cases under NIH Controlled Access)
agent_notes: Unique: paired full-dose/low-dose + RAW PROJECTION DATA (sinograms) for chest/abdomen/head. 1.3 TB total. Foundation for LDCT reconstruction research. Head cases need NIH access.

name: AbdomenAtlas-8K
agent_notes: NeurIPS 2023. 8,448 abdominal CTs (~3.2M slices, 1.2 TB) with 8 organ masks. Largest annotated abdominal CT corpus until 1.1. Author release pipeline; access via HF + JHU forms.

name: M3D-Cap
license: Apache-2.0 (dataset card); source data scraped from Radiopaedia (DMCA notice active)
agent_notes: 120K 3D CT cases scraped from Radiopaedia + paired diagnostic reports. WARNING: HF page DMCA-takedown 2025; treat as unstable mirror. Train code in BAAI-DCAI/M3D.

name: PadChest
license: PadChest Research Use Agreement (free for research; no redistribution)
agent_notes: VLM-paired (Spanish reports; can MT to English). 54 zip files = ~1 TB. ~27% physician-annotated, rest NN-labeled. Hospital San Juan Alicante.

name: PadChest
agent_notes: 168K CXR images / 109K studies / 67K patients with Spanish radiologist reports + 174 findings UMLS-mapped (27% physician-reviewed). Also indexed xr/padchest; dedup target id: xr/padchest.

name: Emory Breast Imaging Dataset (EMBED)
license: EMBED data license (research use, no redistribution; AWS Open Data)
agent_notes: Largest open mammo set (3.4M imgs, 110k pts). 20% public release on AWS Open Data; equal Black/White representation. 2D + C-view; DBT/US/MRI later.

name: BIMCV-COVID19+
agent_notes: 21,342 CR + 34,829 DX + 7,918 CT images from 1,311 COVID-19 patients with anonymized Spanish reports + PCR/IgG/IgM tests. Iteration 1 counts; later iters expanded. Dedup target xr/bimcv_covid + ct/bimcv_covid.

name: AbdomenAtlas 3.0 (RadGPT)
agent_notes: VLM-PAIRED: 9,262 abdominal CTs + medical reports (RadGPT, ICCV 2025). 586 GB. Per-voxel tumor masks for liver/kidney/pancreas. Auto-converted to parquet.

name: MIMIC-CXR (DICOM v2.1.0)
agent_notes: 377K CXR DICOMs / 227K studies + free-text reports (Findings/Impression). Anchor dataset. Also indexed xr/mimic_cxr; dedup target id: xr/mimic_cxr.

name: MIMIC-CXR-JPG
agent_notes: VLM-paired (gold). JPG version of mimic_cxr; no DICOM overhead. PREFERRED for VLM training. Mirrored on GCS for fast pull.

name: CheXpert Plus
agent_notes: 223,462 image-report pairs, 187,711 reports (~36M tokens) sectioned 11 ways + DICOM (47 metadata fields) + 8 demographics. Also indexed xr/chexpert_plus; dedup target id: xr/chexpert.

name: developing Human Connectome Project (dHCP) Neonatal
license: dHCP Open Access Data Use Agreement
agent_notes: 887 datasets from 783 neonates (20-45 wks PMA). Custom 32ch neonatal coil 3T. Best fetal/neonatal brain MRI dataset. AcademicTorrents preferred. Institutional email required.

name: CT COLONOGRAPHY (ACRIN 6664)
agent_notes: 941k images / 825 subjects. Prone+supine paired DICOM. Foundation for CTSpine1K. Best open colonography corpus by image count.

name: CheXpert (Original)
license: Stanford CheXpert Research Use Agreement (academic; no redistribution)
agent_notes: Stanford. 14 labels w/ uncertainty (-1/0/1). Hosted via Redivis; -small 11GB downsampled variant exists for fast iteration.

name: AutoPET-III (FDG + PSMA PET/CT)
agent_notes: Whole-body FDG (1014 studies/900 pts) + PSMA (597/378). 418 GB. Premier oncology PET/CT corpus. NIH Controlled Access for facial recon concerns; expect 2-4 wk approval.

name: Duke Breast Cancer MRI (TCIA)
agent_notes: 922 biopsy-confirmed invasive breast cancers (2000-2014). DCE-MRI pre/post contrast. CC-BY-NC: research-only, no commercial. Use IBM Aspera/TCIA-CLI.

name: CheXpert Plus
license: Stanford CheXpert Plus Research Use Agreement
agent_notes: VLM-paired. CheXpert + reports + demographics + DICOM. 187k reports split into 11 sections. Best Stanford-side complement to MIMIC-CXR.

name: BIMCV-COVID19+
license: BIMCV Research Use Agreement (free for researchers, no redistribution)
agent_notes: VLM-paired (Spanish). 21,342 CR + 34,829 DX + 7,918 CT. Includes PCR/serology + segmentation on 23 imgs. Iterations 1+2+3 DOI 10.21227/f3q6-0986.

name: VinDr-Mammo
agent_notes: 5k exams, 20k images (4 views). Double-read with arbitration. BI-RADS + density + bbox. PhysioNet Restricted (DUA required, non-credentialed allowed).

name: PI-CAI Public Training (Prostate Cancer AI)
agent_notes: 1500 bpMRI from 1476 patients across 3 NL centers (2012-2021). 1295 csPCa lesion masks. Biparametric (T2+DWI+ADC, no DCE). Largest open prostate cancer MRI dataset.

name: M4Raw (Low-Field 0.3T Brain k-space)
agent_notes: 183 healthy at 0.3T. 1024 train + 240 val volumes. T1/T2/FLAIR multi-rep multi-channel. CRITICAL: bridges low-field MRI (Hyperfine, Promaxo) democratization with reconstruction. Companion to fastMRI for low-field.

name: AbdomenAtlas 1.1 Mini
agent_notes: 9,262 CTs with 25-class voxel-level masks. WebDataset format. Largest fully-annotated abdominal CT to date. Touchstone benchmark base. HF token required.

name: AbdomenAtlas 1.0 Mini
agent_notes: NeurIPS 2023 baseline release: 5,195 CTs + 8-organ masks. Sub-collection of AbdomenAtlas-8K. Stable starting point before 1.1 expanded to 25 classes.

name: RSNA Screening Mammography Breast Cancer Detection (2023)
agent_notes: Just under 20k studies (~4 imgs/pt). DICOM with JPEG-2000 compression; conversion is the bottleneck. AU + US screening data.

name: DeepLesion (NIH)
agent_notes: 32,735 lesions, 4,427 patients, 10,594 studies. 2D PNG axial slices (NOT 3D). Excellent for weakly supervised lesion detection pretraining. NIH Box source can be flaky; mirror via Academic Torrents.

name: Calgary-Campinas Multi-Coil k-space (Reconstruction)
agent_notes: 167 raw k-space scans GE 3T (12ch=117, 32ch=50). Companion to fastMRI for reconstruction generalization. CC-BY-ND restricts derivative redistribution.

name: VinDr-CXR
agent_notes: Bounding-box gold standard for CXR detection. 15k train (3 radiologist labels), 3k test (5 radiologist consensus). Vietnam (Hanoi).

name: RSNA Intracranial Hemorrhage Detection 2019
license: RSNA Kaggle competition data license (research use)
agent_notes: 874k DICOM slices / 25k+ exams. Largest open head-CT classification corpus. 5-class hemorrhage subtypes. Also mirrored on AWS Open Data Registry. Kaggle account + competition acceptance required.

name: CBIS-DDSM (Curated Breast Imaging Subset of DDSM)
agent_notes: Open / CC-BY-3.0. 753 calcification + 891 mass cases. Curated DICOM-converted DDSM, with pathology-confirmed masks. Open-license advantage.

name: RSNA-ASNR-MICCAI BraTS 2021
agent_notes: 1480 subjects (originally cited 2040), 4 mpMRI sequences. Pre-processed/co-registered/skull-stripped. Most-downloaded MRI tumor dataset. Synapse for original challenge data; TCIA for finalized.

name: LIDC-IDRI (Lung Image Database Consortium)
agent_notes: Foundational lung CT corpus: 1,010 patients, 1,308 studies, 244k images. 4-radiologist consensus nodule annotations. Underlies LUNA16, NLST training pipelines, and many lung CT pretrains.

name: RSNA STR Pulmonary Embolism Detection 2020
license: RSNA Kaggle competition data license (research use)
agent_notes: 2.32M images / 9,446 CTPA exams from 5 international centers. Largest open CTPA dataset. Size estimated; verify via Kaggle CLI. Also on AWS Open Data Registry.

name: MedICaT
agent_notes: 217K figures from 131K PMC papers (~72% radiology); inline references for 74%; manual subfigure/subcaption annotations on subset. ~104 GB. Application required (research-only). Overlaps PMC-OA.

name: ABIDE I + II (Autism Brain Imaging Data Exchange)
agent_notes: ABIDE I (1112 datasets, 539 ASD/573 controls) + ABIDE II (1114 datasets). 2156 cross-sectional total. INDI/NITRC. Heterogeneous protocols across 24+ sites - useful for domain generalization.

name: RSNA Abdominal Trauma Detection 2023
license: RSNA Kaggle competition data license (research use)
agent_notes: 4,000+ multiphasic abdominal CTs from 23 sites/14 countries. Multi-organ injury labels + segmentation subset. First multiphase RSNA challenge. ~90 GiB classification subset.

name: FLARE 2023: Pan-cancer Abdominal CT
agent_notes: ~4,650 abdominal CTs from 40+ centers spanning all CT phases (plain/artery/portal/delay). 13 organs + tumor. 23x larger than LiTS. Premier abdominal challenge corpus. Size approx; verify on Codalab.

name: VinDr-SpineXR
agent_notes: 10,466 spine X-rays, 5,000 studies; 13 lesion bbox categories. Comprehensive MSK supervision for spine-region modeling.

name: LERA - Lower Extremity Radiographs
license: Stanford AIMI Research Use Agreement (non-commercial only)
agent_notes: Few patients but huge image count (~93k). Foot/ankle/knee/hip. Useful for MSK pretraining. Stanford 2003-2014.

name: EchoNet-LVH
license: Stanford Research Use Agreement (non-commercial research only)
agent_notes: Native AVI at original resolution; PLAX view only; size estimated -- much larger than Dynamic since not downsampled. EULA required.

name: BraTS 2024 Meningioma Radiotherapy (BraTS-MEN-RT)
agent_notes: 570 radiotherapy planning T1-CE 3D MRIs (500 with GTV annotations). Native resolutions, NOT skull-stripped/co-registered (different from prior BraTS). For RT planning workflows.

name: RSNA Cervical Spine Fracture Detection 2022
license: RSNA Kaggle competition data license (research use)
agent_notes: 3,112 CTs (1,445 fracture + 1,667 normal). DICOM volumes + NIfTI vertebral segmentations. Best open cervical-spine CT trauma corpus. Size approximate; confirm via Kaggle CLI.

name: BRAX (Brazilian labeled chest X-ray dataset)
agent_notes: VLM-adjacent (Portuguese-derived labels via NLP, no full reports released). 40,967 imgs from Hospital Israelita Albert Einstein.

name: STOIC2021 COVID-19 CT
agent_notes: 10,735 chest CTs from French wave-1 COVID. Largest open COVID-CT corpus. Severity + outcome labels. Public sample under CC BY-NC; full set requires data-use agreement.

name: ATLAS R2.0 (Anatomical Tracings of Lesions After Stroke)
agent_notes: 1271 T1w stroke MRIs (655 train + 300 test + 316 generalizability). Largest stroke seg dataset. Encryption code via ICPSR after agreement.

name: NIH ChestX-ray14
license: NIH Open Access (research use; no redistribution)
agent_notes: Workhorse open CXR. 112,120 frontal images, 30,805 patients. NLP-mined labels (~90% accuracy). 880 imgs have bboxes. NIH Box only.

name: CheXmask Database (Anatomical Segmentation)
license: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International Public License
agent_notes: 657k masks across ChestX-ray14, CheXpert, MIMIC-CXR-JPG, PadChest, VinDr-CXR. Use as auxiliary segmentation supervision. CC-BY-4.0.

name: ACOUSLIC-AI (Fetal Abdominal Circumference, Blind-Sweep)
license: Creative Commons Attribution NonCommercial ShareAlike 4.0 International
agent_notes: Blind-sweep handheld probe data from Sierra Leone PHUs. v1.1 corrects v1.0 measurement bug (factor of 2). 6 sweeps per case.

name: BraTS-PEDs (Pediatric Brain Tumor Segmentation)
agent_notes: 457 pediatric high-grade gliomas (mostly DMG). Train 257 / val 91 / test 109. IBM Aspera Faspex required. CRITICAL for pediatric oncology generalization.

name: VinDr-PCXR (Pediatric Chest X-Ray)
agent_notes: Largest pediatric CXR with lesion-level + image-level labels. <10yo. PA view. Crucial for age-diverse pretraining.

name: PadChest-GR (bilingual grounded reports)
agent_notes: 4,555 CXR studies (3,099 abnormal / 1,456 normal) with English+Spanish sentence-level grounded reports + bbox annotations. 7,037 positive + 3,422 negative finding sentences. Microsoft+UA+BIMCV. Subset of PadChest.

name: PMC-OA
agent_notes: PubMed Central Open Access biomedical figures with captions; ChatGPT-decomposed compound captions in main split (PMC-OA-Beta keeps originals). Backbone for PMC-CLIP. Overlaps BIOMEDICA/MedICaT.

name: TotalSegmentator v1
agent_notes: 1,204 CTs / 104 structures. v1 release (now superseded by v2/117 classes), keep for backward-compat training and ablation studies.

name: CANDID-PTX (Pneumothorax)
agent_notes: VLM-paired (free-text reports). 19,237 1024x1024 CXRs from Dunedin Hospital NZ. 3,196 PTX cases. Annotated by RANZCR radiologists.

name: AMOS 2022 (Abdominal Multi-Organ Segmentation)
agent_notes: 500 CT + 100 MRI labeled, 15 organs. Multi-vendor multi-phase. AMOS-MM (2024) extends with 2,000+ CT-report pairs and VQA tasks for VLM training.

name: TotalSegmentator v2
agent_notes: 1,228 multi-institution CTs with 117-class voxel masks. Real-world clinical mix (different scanners, contrasts, pathologies). Powers the TotalSegmentator nnU-Net model. v2 supersedes v1's 104 classes.

name: PROMISE12 (Prostate MR Image Segmentation)
agent_notes: 100 T2w prostate MRIs (50 train + 30 test + 20 live). Multi-vendor 4-center. Mhd+raw format - convert to NIfTI. Classic prostate seg benchmark.

name: PMC-VQA
agent_notes: 227K VQA / 149K images / 20+ modality types. v1 (compound figs) + v2 (decomposed). Test-clean (2K) is hand-curated. Hits VQA-RAD/SLAKE/ImageClef-2019 benchmarks.

name: ROCOv2 (Radiology Objects in COntext v2)
agent_notes: 79,789 PMC-derived radiology figures with captions + 1,947 UMLS CUIs. Train/val/test split (~75/12/13). DOI 10.57967/hf/3489. Successor to ROCO 2018.

name: CT-ORG
agent_notes: 140 multi-condition CTs (abdominal, full-body, contrast/non-contrast, low/high-dose). 6-organ masks. Many subjects have liver lesions. Useful for contrast-invariance studies.

name: Pancreatic-CT-CBCT-SEG
agent_notes: 40 patients with paired planning CT + 2 CBCTs each (24,246 images). MSKCC pancreatic radiotherapy. Excellent for CT-CBCT registration / IGRT pretraining.

name: Medical Segmentation Decathlon (CT tasks)
agent_notes: 6 CT tasks (Spleen, Liver, Pancreas, Lung, Colon, Hepatic Vessel) ~1,300 NIfTIs. AWS Open Data S3 mirror, no auth. Standard nnU-Net benchmark. Size approx; tar.gz + raw available.

name: RANZCR CLiP - Catheter and Line Position Challenge
agent_notes: Catheters + lines (ETT, NGT, CVC). 30,083 CXRs from ANZ + sub-set of ChestX-ray14. Critical for ICU/safety models.

name: CTSpine1K
agent_notes: 1,005 CT volumes aggregated from COLONOG, HNSCC-3DCT-RT, MSD Liver, COVID. Largest open spine CT corpus by volume count. Annotations re-derived from heterogeneous source. Size approximate.

name: RSNA Pneumonia Detection Challenge (2018)
agent_notes: 30,227 1024x1024 DICOMs. Subset of NIH ChestX-ray14 with bounding boxes. Standard pneumonia benchmark.

name: TBX11K (Tuberculosis CXR)
license: Nankai University Research Use License (academic, non-commercial)
agent_notes: 11,200 CXRs with TB-region bboxes (rare). 5 classes incl. active vs latent TB. Test set held out via CodaLab challenge.

name: ISLES 2022 (Ischemic Stroke Lesion Segmentation)
agent_notes: 250 multi-center stroke MRIs (TUM Munich + Bern). FLAIR+DWI+ADC. CC-BY-4.0. Successor to ATLAS using diffusion. Test set held out.

name: SIIM-ACR Pneumothorax Segmentation
agent_notes: 12,047 imgs (10,675 train + 1,372 test). RLE-encoded segmentation masks. Pairs well with CANDID-PTX for PTX-focused training.

name: RSNA Pediatric Bone Age Challenge (2017)
agent_notes: 14,236 left-hand X-rays. 0-228 months. Regression target. Useful pediatric MSK adjunct.

name: Pancreas-CT (NIH)
agent_notes: 82 portal-venous abdominal contrast CTs / 80 subjects (53M/27F). Reference baseline for pancreas segmentation. Used as test bed in pancreatic deep learning.

name: IXI Dataset (Healthy Brain MRI)
agent_notes: Nearly 600 healthy adults, 3 London hospitals (Philips 3T, Philips 1.5T, GE 1.5T). T1/T2/PD/MRA/DTI(15-dir). Multi-vendor diversity. Most widely used healthy-brain pretraining dataset.

name: Medical Segmentation Decathlon - Task 1 BrainTumour (BraTS)
agent_notes: MSD subset of BraTS 2017 (484 train, 266 test). aws s3 cp --no-sign-request s3://msd-for-monai/Task01_BrainTumour.tar . Pretrained weights everywhere; classic baseline.

name: EchoNet-Dynamic
license: Stanford Research Use Agreement (non-commercial research only)
agent_notes: Standardized 112x112 AVI videos converted from DICOM; ~150 frames each. Single A4C view. The de facto echo benchmark.

name: EchoNet-Synthetic
license: Same as upstream Stanford EchoNet (non-commercial research)
agent_notes: Latent video diffusion model output paired with synthetic EF labels. Useful for privacy-safe pretraining; do NOT report on this as if real.

name: Calgary-Campinas-359 (Multi-Vendor Brain T1)
agent_notes: 359 T1 brain MRIs across Siemens/Philips/GE at 1.5T+3T (~60 per cell). Used for cross-vendor brain segmentation/skull-stripping benchmarks.

name: crossMoDA 2023 (Vestibular Schwannoma Cross-Modality)
agent_notes: 227 ceT1 + 295 hrT2 (unpaired) train + 96 hrT2 val. Multi-institutional 2023 edition includes routine imaging + 3-class (intra-meatal, extra-meatal tumor, cochlea). Premier UDA benchmark.

name: MSSEG 2016 (Multiple Sclerosis Segmentation)
agent_notes: 53 MS patients, 4 scanners with harmonized protocol. 7-expert consensus + raw per-expert. Test set has unseen scanner. Shanoir registration. Premier MS lesion benchmark.

name: EchoNet-Pediatric
license: Stanford Research Use Agreement (non-commercial research only)
agent_notes: 3,176 A4C + 4,424 PSAX videos, ages 0-18. 112x112 standardized like Dynamic. Domain shift from adult echo.

name: MRNet Stanford Knee MRI
agent_notes: 1370 exams (319 ACL, 508 meniscal). Sagittal/Coronal/Axial. Pre-extracted .npy slices. AIMI shared dataset. Cannot redistribute or share download link.

name: PadChest-GR (Grounded Report Generation)
license: PadChest Research Use Agreement (free for researchers)
agent_notes: VLM-paired, GROUNDED. 4,555 studies, 7,037 positive + 3,422 negative findings, bilingual EN/ES, bboxes per finding. Microsoft + BIMCV. Best grounded-RRG benchmark.

name: FeTA 2024 (Fetal Brain Tissue Annotation)
agent_notes: FeTA 2024 expands to ~200 subjects, multi-center, INCLUDES 0.55T low-field MRI. 7 tissue classes (eCSF, GM, WM, ventricles, cerebellum, brainstem, deep GM). Best fetal brain seg benchmark.

name: M&Ms Multi-Vendor Cardiac MRI Challenge
agent_notes: 350 patients, 4 vendors (Siemens, GE, Philips, Canon), 3 countries. CMR cine. Standard for cross-vendor cardiac generalization. M&Ms-2 (right ventricle) is a separate +160 cases extension.

name: AMOS-MR (Abdominal Multi-Organ Segmentation, MRI subset)
agent_notes: 60 multi-planar multi-sequence abdominal MRI volumes, 15-organ voxel-level annotations. Companion 500 CT cases. Hosted on Zenodo. Cross-modality CT/MR transfer is common use.

name: Shenzhen + Montgomery TB CXR Sets (NLM)
license: NLM Open Access (request via contact form; do not redistribute)
agent_notes: Classic baselines. Shenzhen 662 (326N/336TB) + Montgomery 138 (80N/58TB). Montgomery has lung-segmentation masks. Small, but durable benchmark.

name: Open-i / IU CXR (Indiana University)
agent_notes: 7,470 frontal/lateral CXR + 3,955 reports (Comparison/Indication/Findings/Impression). Anchor benchmark for CXR report-gen evals. Also indexed xr/iu_xray; dedup target id: xr/iu_xray.

name: MURA - Musculoskeletal Radiographs
license: Stanford ML Group Research Use Agreement (non-commercial)
agent_notes: 40,561 imgs (12,173 patients). Elbow, finger, forearm, hand, humerus, shoulder, wrist. Board-cert radiologist labels. PNG, small footprint.

name: Open-i / Indiana University Chest X-Rays
license: Indiana University / NLM Open Access (research; check indiv. records)
agent_notes: VLM-paired. 7,470 imgs / 3,955 reports w/ Comparison/Indication/Findings/Impression. De facto VLM benchmark for report-generation eval.

name: MIMIC-Ext-MIMIC-CXR-VQA
agent_notes: VLM instruction-tuning gold. 48 templates x 7 content types over MIMIC-CXR-JPG (must download separately). Pairs with mimic_cxr_jpg.

name: COVIDx-US Lung Ultrasound Benchmark
license: GNU Affero General Public License 3.0 (mixed CC-BY-NC variants on source data)
agent_notes: v1.5 release; AGPL means viral copyleft for derived models distributed -- check before commercial pretraining. Heterogeneous source devices.

name: RP3D-DiagDS (RadFM source)
format_native: JSON (text only; image links to Radiopaedia)
agent_notes: 39,026 cases / 195,010 scans / 9 modalities / 7 anatomical regions / 5,568 disorders + 930 ICD-10-CM. Text-only on HF (2.22 GB); images scraped separately. Foundation for RadFM/MedMD.

name: CHAOS Combined Healthy Abdominal Organ (MRI subset)
agent_notes: 40 patients, 120 datasets (T1-DUAL in/out + T2-SPIR). 4-organ segmentation. Pairs with 40 CT cases for cross-modality. Letter of intent + registration.

name: FETAL_PLANES_DB (Burgos-Artizzu)
agent_notes: Frames (still images), not video. Two-hospital Spanish collection. Brain subdivides into 3 sub-planes.

name: ACDC (Automated Cardiac Diagnosis Challenge)
agent_notes: 150 cine SSFP exams, 5 groups (HCM, DCM, MI, abnormal RV, healthy). Train 100 + test 50. Most-cited cardiac MRI seg benchmark.

name: EMIDEC (Delayed-Enhancement Cardiac MRI)
agent_notes: 150 short-axis LGE MRIs (50 normal + 100 MI). Myocardium + infarct + no-reflow zone. Clinical features included for multimodal models.

name: RVENet (Right Ventricular Echocardiography)
license: Non-commercial research use only; sharing prohibited
agent_notes: DICOM A4C videos with 3D-derived RVEF as ground truth. Heterogeneous patient cohorts (athletes, HF, transplant, valve).

name: COVID-BLUES Lung Ultrasound
size_human: ~1.3 GB (estimate; 31,746 frames at 60-100 frames per video)
agent_notes: Prospective study, single device (Philips Lumify), 6 BLUE points per patient. NoDerivs license blocks fine-tuning if derivative is redistributed.

name: MedMD (RadFM training corpus)
agent_notes: 16M 2D image-text pairs + 500K 3D scans, paired with reports/captions/diagnoses. Distributed as text manifest (668 MB CSV); images sourced from PMC-Inline/PMC-CaseReport/RP3D/MPx/MIMIC etc. Heavy overlap with PMC-OA/MedICaT.

name: TN3K (Thyroid Nodule Segmentation)
agent_notes: Zhujiang Hospital data. Train 2879 / test 614. Pixel masks + binary class labels both included.

name: PSFHS Intrapartum Ultrasound (Pubic Symphysis + Fetal Head)
agent_notes: 256x256 single-channel images with paired masks. MICCAI 2023 challenge data. Newer than HC18; complementary task.

name: LLaVA-Med Alignment 500K (PMC-15M sample)
agent_notes: 500K figure-caption pairs sampled from PMC-15M for stage-1 alignment in LLaVA-Med. JSON manifest 358 MB; images downloaded from PMC. NeurIPS 2023 Spotlight.

name: TMED-2 (Tufts Medical Echocardiogram Dataset)
size_human: ~350 MB (estimate; sampled frames not full videos)
license: Non-commercial research; agreement required via Tufts
agent_notes: 599 studies, 577 patients. 5 view classes + AS diagnosis (none/early/significant). Sampled frames -- NOT video.

name: TG3K (Thyroid Gland Segmentation)
agent_notes: Companion to TN3K -- 3585 frames extracted from 16 ultrasound videos, gland masks only. Often paired with TN3K for multi-task training.

name: GBCU (Gallbladder Cancer Ultrasound)
agent_notes: License restricted to permanent faculty/employees of requesting institution. CVPR 2022. First public GBC dataset.

name: Medical Decathlon Task05 Prostate MRI
agent_notes: 48 mpMRI cases (T2 + ADC). 2-channel small benchmark. aws s3 cp --no-sign-request s3://msd-for-monai/Task05_Prostate.tar . Quick sanity-check baseline.

name: SLAKE (Semantically-Labeled Knowledge-Enhanced VQA)
agent_notes: 14,028 VQA pairs / 642 images / 10 content types (modality/position/organ/abnormality/size/etc.). Bilingual (en+zh). Open + Closed question types. ISBI 2021 oral. Standard MedVQA benchmark.

name: BUSI (Breast Ultrasound Images, Cairo)
license: Open Database License (ODbL); see Data in Brief paper
agent_notes: Most-cited breast US dataset. 437 benign, 210 malignant, 133 normal. Some duplicate images and missing-mask cases noted in 2023 PMC errata.

name: HMC-QU (Hamad-Qatar Echo, Myocardial Infarction)
agent_notes: Multi-view (A4C+A2C) labeled subset. 109 A4C with LV-wall masks (72 MI, 37 non-MI). NOTE: not M-mode despite some descriptions; primarily 2D B-mode.

name: POCOVID (Born et al. POCUS COVID-19)
agent_notes: Many videos sourced from grepmed/ Italian POCUS atlas; not all redistributable -- run get_and_process_web_data.sh. Avoid frame-level splits (see README).

name: BUS-BRA (Brazilian Breast Ultrasound)
agent_notes: Permissive CC-BY. Biopsy-proven labels. Larger and more permissive than BUSI.

name: LLaVA-Med Instruct 60K
agent_notes: 60K GPT-4-generated multi-round conversations across CXR/CT/MRI/histopath/grosspath. Stage-2 instruct-tuning data for LLaVA-Med. Pairs with the 500K alignment set.

name: BrEaST (Breast Lesions USG, TCIA)
agent_notes: 266 segmented lesions in 256 scans. Histopathology-confirmed. TCIA-hosted, CC-BY -- safe for any pretraining.

name: BUS-UCLM (Spain Breast US Segmentation)
agent_notes: Single Spanish hospital, single Siemens device. 174 benign, 90 malignant, 419 normal. Useful as held-out cross-domain test for BUSI/BUS-BRA.

name: HC18 (Fetal Head Circumference)
agent_notes: 999 train + 335 test PNG, 800x540. Ellipse parameters as labels. Single-image task -- no video.

name: VQA-RAD
agent_notes: 2,244 clinician-generated QA / 314 MedPix radiology images. Train 1,793 + Test 451. Yes/no + open-ended. Public-domain (CC0). Standard MedVQA eval. Train data for many recent MedVLMs.

name: UDIAT Dataset B (Sabadell Breast US)
agent_notes: 109 benign + 54 malignant. Siemens ACUSON. Frequently paired with BUSI/UCLM for cross-vendor evaluation. Application required.

name: DDTI (Digital Database Thyroid Imaging)
license: Open access (CIMA Lab Universidad Nacional de Colombia)
agent_notes: IDIME Colombia. Includes thyroiditis/goiter/cancer diversity. Native is XML+JPG; pre-parsed Kaggle mirror is most usable.
